rust_summary: an item's default components on `Host` (`native_item_default_component`), which `ItemResource::with_component` and `without_component` read to keep a stack's patch as vanilla's.
doc_summary: `item_default_component(item, component)` is an item's default value of a data component (`Item.components().get`), with data packs' and mods' changes, or none where it hasn't one; `ItemResource::with_component(host, &id, value)` drops a value equal to it from a stack's patch, and `without_component(host, &id)` records a removal (`!id`) of one the item has, as vanilla's `PatchedDataComponentMap.set` and `remove` do. Bundles need "hooks": @API:item_components@.
